vat.name: Value Added Tax
vat.statute: Value Added Tax Act Cap. V1 LFN 2004 s. 4 as substituted by the Finance Act 2020 s. 42 (7,5 % from 1 February 2020); Finance Act 2023 Part IX (ss. 22-24) does not amend s. 4; Finance Act 2021 not held
vat.doc: Finance Act 2020 (OCR) s. 42: "Substitute for section 4 of the Act, a new section '4': 'Rate of tax. 4. The tax shall be computed at the rate of 7.5% with effect from 1 February 2020, on the value of all goods and services, except that goods and services listed under Part III of the First Schedule to this Act shall be taxed at zero rate.'" Finance Act 2023 Part IX amends ss. 7, 14 and 16 only. The Nigeria Tax Act 2025 applies from 1 January 2026. Grade B: the FA 2021 (and FA 2022, if any) were not held.
notes: First Schedule Part I/II exemptions (basic food items, medical and pharmaceutical products, books, educational materials, ...) and Part III zero-rated items are not applied: the schedules were not read
unsupported: First Schedule exemptions and zero-rated items
